_doc: City/neighborhood hero-video curation worksheet for scripts/sync-city-videos.mjs. Each entry maps a geo slug to a CLEAN Drive B-roll clip. geo_tags come from the Drive folder/city. Run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/sync-city-videos.mjs --only <slug>. driveFileId=null means awaiting a clean clip. NOTE: the snowdrift 'Area Guide' clips are finished marketing videos with text/voiceover overlays — not ideal as silent looping heroes; review before using.
